flags: CDOT and the byway article give 129 miles; material maps 149.5. Use CDOT’s attributed figure rather than calling the mapped itinerary 129 miles. Reverse the cached route description to match strip-town order, ending at Alamosa East.
No cache source gives byway construction or designation chronology. Cumbres highway realignment supplies the road-history paragraph without conflating it with railroad construction.

Conejos gives parish founding in 1858; Antonito claims 1857 and the oldest church building. Omitted disputed founding date and construction claim. CDOT distinguishes oldest parish in Conejos from oldest church building at San Acacio.
The cached June 21 dedication described as the Feast of Saint Louis lacks corroboration. Dropped that precise date from the current San Luis narrative.

Fort museum source groups restored and reconstructed buildings without identifying each building’s surviving fabric. Wording preserves that distinction; no claim that Carson’s original quarters stand intact.
Fort and settlement history has no tribal or primary historical cache source. Kept the limited documented Ute land episode and did not repeat the source’s generalized conflict language.
